HC = precast hollow-core plank field (รายการประกอบพื้นสำเร็จรูปชนิดแผ่นกลวง HC on this sheet, safe load 300 kg/m2); the classroom bays have no beam at row B or C on this floor, so each HC field spans A-D with planks running along x between the transverse beams.
Levels: +0.70 is printed in bays 2-3, 8-9 (twice, both halves of the sheet) and 15-16 and in the stair halls; +0.65 on S6 (A-B) in both stair halls.
